post.description:
Handler for creating a new training job.

It will create the following entities:
1. A new graph if the current definition doesn't exist.
2. A new predictive query.
And trigger the following jobs:
1. Graph snapshot job to snapshot the latest data for the Graph.
2. Training table generation job to generate training tables. Training
table specs from TrainingJobRequest.training_table_gen_plan will be
used.
3. A new training job. Graph data from (1), Training table from (2)
and ModelPlan from request.model_plan will be used.

Args:
    request (TrainingJobRequest): The request object containing all
    necessary information to start a training job, including graph
    definition, predictive query, and model plan.
Returns:
    TrainingJobID: The ID of the initiated training job.

get.description:
Used to generate a fully executable Python SDK script to reproduce a training pipeline
in the SDK. The script contains:
    1. Connector(s) config(s). If there are tables from multiple connectors,
    we load the config for each connector.
    2. Table configs structured as Python dictionaries.
    3. Graph edge configs.
    4. Using the aforementioned configs to setup a graph in the SDK.
    5. Predictive query config.
    6. Training table config.
    7. Model plan config.
    8. Use the graph and configs to generate a training table and training jobs.
       Additionally, give the option to load a training table with ID
       instead of generating a new one.

This method is part of the UI to SDK feature and will be called in the UI.

Args:
    training_job_id (TrainingJobID): ID of the training job.
    ctx (RequestContext): Request context.
Response:
    str: The complete python script for an SDK training workflow as a string.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If training job cannot be retrieved.

Column.title: Column
Column.description:
A column in a Kumo table.

``multicategorical_delimiter`` records how a scalar string
multi-categorical column was split when its metadata was inferred. Kumo
persists this value in the table definition so every later validation,
snapshot, and training operation uses the same interpretation. It may be
a comma (``,``), pipe (``|``), semicolon (``;``), or tab (``\t``).

Resolved scalar string multi-categorical columns must carry this proof.
Only the pre-inference :class:`ColumnMetadataRequest` may defer it. Native
list-valued multi-categorical columns are already structurally separated
and therefore do not use a delimiter. Columns with another semantic type
cannot specify one either.

CustomSQLSourceTable.title: CustomSQLSourceTable
CustomSQLSourceTable.description:
A source table whose rows are produced by a read-only SELECT that runs
in the customer's data warehouse.

The query is pushed down and executed unchanged; only its result set is
ingested. As the query has no underlying physical table, ``table``
carries a stable synthetic identifier that downstream cache, staging, and
data-versioning pipelines key on.

``connector_type`` and ``referenced_tables`` are server-owned. The server
derives ``connector_type`` from ``connector_id`` (recording which
warehouse backs the query --
snowflake/databricks/bigquery -- so the persisted def is self-describing;
file-based connectors are rejected) and parses ``referenced_tables`` from
``sql`` (the external tables the query reads, used for lineage and change
detection). Unresolved requests omit both fields; resolved definitions
carry the authoritative values through later lifecycle operations.

GoogleAmbientAuthentication.title: GoogleAmbientAuthentication
GoogleAmbientAuthentication.description:
Use only Kumo's verified ambient GCP workload identity chain.

The GCP analogue of :class:`S3AmbientAuthentication`. This public
contract has no service-account or credential fields: when Kumo is
deployed on GCP, its pods already run as a Workload Identity service
account, so the customer grants that service account IAM access to their
bucket/dataset and Kumo authenticates via Application Default
Credentials with NO impersonation and NO uploaded key. The deployment's
launch configuration supplies the approved service-account allowlist and
may disable ambient GCP entirely. Static, environment, shared-file, and
metadata-less credentials are never selected by this mode.

GraphSnapshotRequest.title: GraphSnapshotRequest
GraphSnapshotRequest.description:
A config object used to fetch graph snapshot.
In the SDK, a training and a training table job can be triggered with different graphs.
The UI should show the appropriate graph for each (currently we only show the graph snapshot for
the training table generation job). The get_graph_snapshot endpoint takes graph definition and graph
version as additional arguments. If those are supplied, the endpoint relies on them to fetch the graph snapshot.
Otherwise, it only relies on the graph snapshot ID.

Index.title: Index
Index.description:
An :class:`Index` encoder encodes its corresponding categorical column
by assigning each unique value with frequency above :obj:`min_occ` to an
embedding of size :obj:`channels` from the model plan. Values below this
frequency are all collapsed to the same embedding.

JobState.description: The status of a Kumo job, associated with a stateful resource.

JobTagRequest.title: JobTagRequest
JobTagRequest.description: Used when adding and deleting tags associated with a job.

LinkPredOutputType.title: LinkPredOutputType
LinkPredOutputType.description:
Concrete link-prediction module to use.

.. note::
   Embeddings (``return_embeddings=True``) are fully supported only for
   ``SHALLOW_RHS`` and ``TWO_TOWER``. ``CONTEXT`` produces embeddings that
   do not perfectly align with the predicted ranking, and ``PAIRWISE``
   does not support embedding output at all.

LinkPredRFM.description:
RFM for link prediction.

        each entity.

        historical overlapped items for each entity.
    num_true_items (int, optional): The number of truth items for each
        entity.
    num_true_hist_items (int, optional): The number of true and historical
        overlapped items for each entity.

LocalFileSourceTable.title: LocalFileSourceTable
LocalFileSourceTable.description:
A source table that is a file on the filesystem of the reading process.

Deliberately *not* a member of :obj:`SourceTableType`: it travels only on
:attr:`~kumoapi.jobs.CustomTrainingTable.source_table`.

MaterializationTaskInfo.title: MaterializationTaskInfo
MaterializationTaskInfo.description:
Information about the tables that were ingested & materialized, during a
training or batch prediction job. Some of information is made available to
the user, so that they can understand exactly which input data was used to
train the model.

This also contains a bunch of additional debug information that can be
exposed in the UI for Kumo engineers.

MaterializedTableInfo.title: MaterializedTableInfo
MaterializedTableInfo.description: Metadata about an individual table that was materialized.

MaxLogNumerical.title: MaxLogNumerical
MaxLogNumerical.description:
A :class:`MaxLogNumerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column, after applying the transformation

.. math::
    \log \left( \frac{\text{feature} - (\text{min} - 1)}{1.0} \right)

and using a strategy for null value imputation specified by
:obj:`na_strategy`.

MinLogNumerical.title: MinLogNumerical
MinLogNumerical.description:
A :class:`MinLogNumerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column, after applying the transformation

.. math::
    \log \left( \frac{\text{feature} - (\text{max} + 1)}{-1.0} \right)

and using a strategy for null value imputation specified by
:obj:`na_strategy`.

MultiCategorical.title: MultiCategorical
MultiCategorical.description:
A :class:`MultiCategorical` encoder encodes its corresponding
multicategorical column by treating each categorical value independently,
and fusing the results.

NodeDegreeStats.title: NodeDegreeStats
NodeDegreeStats.description: Node degree statistics for train table.

NodePredRFM.title: NodePredRFM
NodePredRFM.description:
RFM for node prediction.

Args:

        second-hop items for each second hop table.

Null.title: Null
Null.description: A :class:`Null` encoder skips encoding its corresponding column.

Numerical.title: Numerical
Numerical.description:
A :class:`Numerical` encoder encodes its corresponding numerical
column with a normalization specified by :obj:`scaler` and strategy for
null value imputation specified by :obj:`na_strategy`.

NumericalList.title: NumericalList
NumericalList.description:
A :class:`NumericalList` encoder encodes numerical sequences by
treating these sequences as input features with a normalization specified
by :obj:`scaler`.

PartUploadMetadata.title: PartUploadMetadata
PartUploadMetadata.description: Metadata for a single part of a multipart upload.

PredictionTableGenerationPlan.title: PredictionTableGenerationPlan
PredictionTableGenerationPlan.description:
Configuration parameters that define the construction of a Kumo
prediction table from a predictive query.

:ivar anchor_time: (``int`` | ``"inferred"`` | ``datetime.datetime``) The
    time that a prediction horizon start time of "zero" refers to. If not
    set, will be inferred to be the latest timestamp in the target fact
    table. Note that this value can either be provided as an integer,
    representing the number of nanoseconds from the Unix epoch, or as a
    ``datetime.datetime`` object (*default:* ``"inferred"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar forecast_length: (``int``) Turns a node regression problem into a
    forecasting problem (*default:* ``"missing"``). Must be provided if the
    model was trained using this parameter.
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal Regression

:ivar lag_timesteps: (``int``) For forecasting problems,
    leverage the auto-regressive labels as inputs. This parameter controls
    the number of previous values that should be considered as
    auto-regressive labels (*default:* ``"missing"``). Must be provided if
    the model was trained using this parameter.
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal Regression

:ivar year_over_year: (``bool``) For forecasting problems, integrate
    Year-Over-Year features as inputs to give more attention to the data
    from the previous year when making a prediction. Must be provided if
    the model was trained using this parameter.
    (*default:* ``"missing"``)

ProjectDBEntry.title: ProjectDBEntry
ProjectDBEntry.description:
A scoped workspace referencing tables and graphs.

A project always belongs to exactly one immutable Kumo group. Visibility within
that group is controlled by is_private:
- Private (is_private=True): owner-only.
- Shared (is_private=False): visible to all members of the group.

Every connector, table, graph, job, and upload belongs exclusively to this
project and cannot be linked into another project.

ProjectUploadConnectorResponse.title: ProjectUploadConnectorResponse
ProjectUploadConnectorResponse.description: Safe reference to the hidden upload connector for one project.

QueryType.title: QueryType
QueryType.description: Defines the type of a predictive query.

RHSEmbeddingMode.title: RHSEmbeddingMode
RHSEmbeddingMode.description:
Specifies how to incorporate shallow RHS representations in link
prediction tasks.

heatmap in the UI

ReplaceIdentityGroupsArgs.title: ReplaceIdentityGroupsArgs

S3AccessKeyAuthentication.title: S3AccessKeyAuthentication
S3AccessKeyAuthentication.description: Use an explicitly stored S3 access key instead of AWS STS.

S3AmbientAuthentication.title: S3AmbientAuthentication
S3AmbientAuthentication.description:
Use only Kumo's verified ambient AWS workload identity chain.

This public contract has no role or credential fields. The deployment's
launch configuration supplies the approved role allowlist and may disable
ambient S3 entirely. Static, environment, shared-file, SSO, and anonymous
credentials are never selected by this mode.

S3AnyURIConnectorTarget.title: S3AnyURIConnectorTarget
S3AnyURIConnectorTarget.description:
Require a canonical full S3 URI on every object operation.

Region selection is intentionally per request; connector-wide region
configuration is forbidden in this mode. Discovery remains unavailable.

S3ConnectionConfig.title: S3ConnectionConfig
S3ConnectionConfig.description:
Optional transport settings for an S3 identity.

Omitting this object preserves the AWS SDK endpoint, region, addressing,
and system TLS defaults used by existing identities.  A custom endpoint
requires an explicit SigV4 signing region.

S3ConnectorResourceConfig.title: S3ConnectorResourceConfig

S3RelativeSource.title: S3RelativeSource

S3RootedConnectorTarget.title: S3RootedConnectorTarget

``S3URISource`` only with any-URI connectors.

S3URISource.title: S3URISource
S3URISource.description: A canonical full S3 URI used by an any-URI connector.

SourceColumn.title: SourceColumn
SourceColumn.description:
The metadata of a column in a source table. Note that a source column
simply provides a view into the metadata of a source table. To modify
metadata, please create a Kumo Table and adjust the table's data and
semantic types.

.. note::
    Semantic types are inferred based on data types only, and thus may not
    be accurate.

Args:
    name (str): The name of the column.
    stype (Stype, optional): The semantic type of the column.
    dtype (Dtype): The data type of the column
    is_primary (bool): Whether the column refers to a primary key.
    multicategorical_delimiter: The proven separator for a scalar string
        multi-categorical source column, if one was inferred.

SplitSizes.title: SplitSizes
SplitSizes.description: Number of training/eval examples in each of the splits

StartFileUploadRequest.title: StartFileUploadRequest
StartFileUploadRequest.description: A request to begin an AWS S3 multipart file upload.

StartFileUploadResponse.title: StartFileUploadResponse
StartFileUploadResponse.description: The server response to an initiation of a file upload.

Stype.title: Stype
Stype.description:
The semantic type of a column.

A semantic type denotes the semantic meaning of a column, and determines
the preprocessing that is applied to the column. Semantic types can be
passed to methods in the SDK as strings (*e.g.* ``"numerical"``).

.. note::

    For more information about how to select a semantic type, please
    refer to https://docs.kumo.ai/docs/column-preprocessing.

Attributes:
    numerical: A numerical column. Typically integers or floats.
    categorical: A categorical column. Typically boolean or string values
        typically a single token in length.
    multicategorical: A multi-categorical column. Typically a concatenation
        of multiple categories under a single string representation.
    ID: A column holding IDs. Typically numerical values used to uniquely
        identify different entities.
    text: A text column. String values typically multiple tokens in length,
        where the actual language content of the value has semantic
        meaning.
    timestamp: A date/time column.
    sequence: A column holding sequences/embeddings. Consists of lists of
        floats, all of equal length, and are typically the output of
        another AI model
    image: A column holding image URLs.

SubgraphFeatureStore.title: SubgraphFeatureStore
SubgraphFeatureStore.description:
Stores the feature columns records for column for
each node in the subgraph.

Args:

        of feature columns for each node, where key for each node
        is the column name and the value is the feature column.

SubgraphNode.title: SubgraphNode
SubgraphNode.description:
Represents a node in the subgraph.

Args:
    id (int): The unique integer ID of the node.
    pkey_name (str, optional): The name of the primary key column.
    pkey (Any, optional): The value of the primary key.

SubgraphStore.title: SubgraphStore
SubgraphStore.description:
Stores the subgraph structure, including the ID for entity (root)
node, nodes and edges. The nodes are stored in a dictionary with the
node ID as the key. The edges are stored in a dictionary with the source
node ID as the key and a dictionary of relation types to a list of
destination node IDs. The tables for each node are stored in a dictionary
with the table name as the key.

Args:
    root_id (int): The ID of the root node.
    task_type (TaskType): The type of the task.
    seed_time (datetime, optional): The seed time of the subgraph.
    nodes (Dict[int, Union[SubgraphNode, AggregatedNodes]], optional):
        The nodes in the subgraph.
    edges (Dict[int, Dict[str, List[int]]], optional): The edges in
        the subgraph, where the key is the source node ID and the value
        is a dictionary of relation types to a list of destination node
        IDs.
    tables (Dict[str, List[int]], optional): The list of node IDs
        for each table.

TextEmbedding.title: TextEmbedding
TextEmbedding.description:

TimePeriod.title: TimePeriod
TimePeriod.description:
Represents a range of time for a split of the training table. The
timestamps should refer to the time_col of the original source table.
It can be either pseudo time column or standard time column.

In case of pseudo time column, the start and end are always integers and
they are inclusive on both ends.

In case of standard time column, it is undefined whether the start and end
are inclusive or exclusive. However, in default split algorithm
`DateOffsetSplit`, the end is exclusive. Start is guaranteed to be equal or
earlier in time compared to end.

        ``0`` for train, ``1`` for validation and ``2`` for test. The
        column is read out of the supplied table by name, routes the row,
        and is dropped from the seed output. ``None`` leaves the split to
        the generation plan.

kumoapi__model_plan__TrainingTableGenera.title: TrainingTableGenerationPlan
kumoapi__model_plan__TrainingTableGenera.description:
Configuration parameters that define the construction of a Kumo
training table from a predictive query. Please see the
`Kumo documentation <https://docs.kumo.ai/docs/advanced-operations
#training-table-generation>`_ for more information.

:ivar split: (``str``) A custom split that is used to generate a training,
    validation, and test set in the training table
    (*default:* ``"inferred"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** All

:ivar train_start_offset: (``int`` | ``"inferred``") Defines the numerical
    offset from the most recent entry to use to generate training data
    labels. Unless a custom time unit is specified in the aggregation, this
    value is in days (*default:* ``"inferred"``). Eventually we would
    like to migrate this parameter to start_time.
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar train_end_offset: (``int`` | ``"inferred"``) Defines the numerical
    offset from the most recent entry to not use to generate training data
    labels. Unless a custom time unit is specified in the aggregation, this
    value is in days (*default:* ``"inferred"``). Eventually we would
    like to migrate this parameter to end_time.
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar start_time: (``int`` | ``"inferred"`` | ``str``) Defines the absolute
    start time to use for generating training data. Can be specified
    either as a pandas Timestamp compatible string (e.g. '2024-04-01') or
    as a non-positive integer offset in days from the current time
    (e.g. -30 for 30 days ago) (*default:* ``"inferred"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar end_time: (``int`` | ``"inferred"`` | ``str``) Defines the absolute
    end time to use for generating training data. Can be specified either
    as a pandas Timestamp compatible string (e.g. '2024-04-01') or as a
    non-positive integer offset in days from the current time
    (e.g. -30 for 30 days ago) (*default:* ``"inferred"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar timeframe_step: (``int`` | ``"inferred"``) Defines the step size of
    generating time intervals for training table generation
    (*default:* ``"inferred"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal

:ivar forecast_length: (``int``) Turns a node regression problem into a
    forecasting problem (*default:* ``"missing"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal Regression

:ivar lag_timesteps: (``int``) For forecasting problems,
    leverage the auto-regressive labels as inputs. This parameter controls
    the number of previous values that should be considered as
    auto-regressive labels (*default:* ``"missing"``).
    **Supported Task Types:** Temporal Regression

:ivar year_over_year: (``bool``) For forecasting problems, integrate
    Year-Over-Year features as inputs to give more attention to the data
    from the previous year when making a prediction.
    (*default:* ``"missing"``)

:ivar weight_col: (``str`` | ``None``) Column on the target table to use
    for weighting training examples (*default:* ``None``).
    **Supported Task Types:** All static queries and temporal link
    prediction.
